name: Bill Novotny
prior_offices: Johnson County commissioner (won the November 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2026; described as commission chair in a December 2022 Sheridan Media report)
background: Bill Novotny is a Johnson County commissioner and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. Sheridan Media reported in December 2022 that he was commission chair when the board appointed Jackie Camino as clerk, and later reported that he and Jeff Shelley, both incumbents, advanced from the 2026 primary and were selected in the general election. The Buffalo Bulletin reported that he received 2,615 votes in the general election.
